newsitem.title: UK: Thames Water to pay 230 mln stg windfall tax.
newsitem.headline: Thames Water to pay 230 mln stg windfall tax.

text.p: Britain's Thames Water Plc said on Thursday it expected to pay around 230 million stg in windfall tax imposed in Wednesday's budget on privatised utitilies.
Thames Water said it would be able to maintain investment programmes but added that there would be an impact on its business.

"We will borrow to pay the tax and so in the short term customers' bills will not be affected. However, the medium-term regulatory implications for investment and pricing will eventually need to be discussed with (water industry regulator) OFWAT," Thames Water said in a statement.
Thames Water is Britain's largest water provider, serving 11 million customers in London and southern England.

The company called the expected tax large but said the distribution of the tax in the water sector "acknowledged the handicap Thames was given at the time of flotation when we had no cash injection and a relatively high flotation value compared to profits."
